Cc: Sarah Liang <sarah.liang@opsilon.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 21:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: late evening executive briefing (Opsilon/CIO)

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the fast responses this week. Our CIO, Priya Venkataraman, is traveling back from EMEA and the only time she can reliably join next week is after 21:00 UTC on Thu/Fri (that maps to late-evening PT for you). She specifically asked to see an executive overview + a short run-through of the platform capabilities and a high-level SOW.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you provide a senior exec (VP or above) to lead the first 15 minutes for strategic alignment?
- We need a recording enabled and a short agenda so Priya can prep.

We can do either Thu 2027-07-01 21:00 UTC or Fri 2027-07-02 21:00 UTC. If neither works, we can push to the following week but prefer to keep momentum.

I attached a one-pager that outlines the business context.

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Park
Head of Platform Partnerships, Opsilon
jamie@opsilon.com
Attachment: opsilon-context-onepager.pdf

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: late evening executive briefing (Opsilon/CIO)

Hi Jamie —

Appreciate the heads-up and the one-pager. We can absolutely support a late-evening slot. Short answer: Ben (VP, GTM) can lead the exec portion and I’ll have Rishi cover technical Q&A.

Proposed plan (keeps it tight for Priya):
- 21:00 UTC — 21:15 UTC: Strategic overview (Ben)
- 21:15 UTC — 21:35 UTC: Live demo focused on latency/cost/playbook (Rishi + me)
- 21:35 UTC — 21:50 UTC: SOW highlights + next steps (Vanessa)
- Recording + access to the deck shared after the call

Can you confirm which of the two dates works for Priya? Also: do you need us to sign any confidentiality addendum before the session? I attached a short agenda and a draft SOW for Opsilon to review.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Vanessa / Ben / Rishi —

Fri 2027-07-02 21:00 UTC works for Priya. Thank you for the quick turnaround and for agreeing to lead. A few housekeeping items before the call:
- Please enable recording and share the recording + slides within 24 hours after the call.
- We have a standard mutual NDA on file but if you prefer DocuSign for the SOW we can route that after the briefing.
- Can you confirm the dial-in (we prefer Google Meet) and whether you’ll share a short pre-read (Ben’s 1-pager) by Thu 2027-07-01 EOD?

Will send a calendar invite for Fri and include Priya and Sarah. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Jamie
